sloka: देवता नाभिनन्दन्ति धर्मयुक्तेन केनचित् ।येन त्वमीदृशं भावं नीतस्सन्नावबुद्ध्यसे ।। ७.१५.२० ॥
transliteration: devatā nābhinandanti dharmayuktena kenacit ।yena tvamīdṛśaṁ bhāvaṁ nītassannāvabuddhyase ।। 7.15.20 ॥

translations.english: The gods do not approve of such a state, nor does any righteous person, by which you have been brought to this condition and yet do not understand it.
